answer: A conference program committee tenure with review assignment history works as the gate: reviews assigned by one conference for years. Each of 260 aliases needs its own assignment histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The sable test is the price tag: 260 fakes mean 260 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The ivory signal is visible to every grader, and the nadir ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
